events.title_zh: PNC Chief Says Flooded Tents Mark Another Chapter in Gaza's Ghastly Humanitarian Crisis
events.title_original: PNC Chief Says Flooded Tents Mark Another Chapter in Gaza's Ghastly Humanitarian Crisis
events.summary: Ramallah, November 07 (QNA) - The ordeal engulfing displaced Gazans as a result of harsh weather conditions, with rainwater flooding their tents and shelters collapsing over their occupants, marks a new chapter in the ghastly humanitarian catastrophe, amid the absence of shelter and even the most basic necessities of life and protection, said Rawhi Fattouh, chairman of the Palestinian National Council (PNC).  （原文待翻译）
